name: >Start >Fight >Run
source:
‘This is a small visual novel made for Ludum Dare (and as such, I made it easy as to not try anyone’s patience.) The theme was, “It’s dangerous to go alone! Take this!”’

[From [url=http://bentosmile.com/mini-games/start-fight-run/]official website[/url]]
